about.paragraph: We are a study visa consultancy built on one simple promise: honest guidance. We tell you what fits your marks, your budget and your goals — not what sounds good. From your first free counselling session to the university shortlist, the application, the visa file and the morning you board your flight, one team walks the whole road with you.

countriesSection.title: Seven countries. One flight path.
countriesSection.note: Figures are indicative and change often. We confirm the latest numbers in your counselling session.

countries.overview: Welcoming immigration pathways, a large Indian community and strong college-to-career programs make Canada a favourite for diploma and PG students.
countries.name: Canada
countries.work: Post-Graduation Work Permit of up to 3 years (program dependent)

countries.overview: One-year master's degrees, world-ranked universities and a post-study work route make the UK a fast, prestigious option.
countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.work: Graduate Route work visa after graduation (duration as per current rules)

countries.overview: High quality of life, part-time work rights during study and globally recognised degrees across IT, health and engineering.
countries.name: Australia

countries.overview: The widest choice of universities and courses in the world, with strong STEM programs and OPT work experience after graduation.
countries.name: United States
countries.work: OPT of 12 months, plus a 24-month extension for eligible STEM degrees

countries.overview: Tuition-free or low-cost public universities and a strong engineering industry — ideal for students with good academics.
countries.name: Germany
countries.tuition: Public: low / no tuition + semester fee · Private: €10,000 – 25,000 / year
countries.work: 18-month residence permit to look for work after graduation

countries.overview: Europe's tech and pharma hub, English-speaking, with one-year master's programs and a post-study stay-back option.
countries.name: Ireland

countries.overview: Safe, friendly and scenic, with practical programs and clear post-study work options.
countries.name: New Zealand
countries.work: Post-study work visa of up to 3 years (qualification dependent)
